name: list_named_sandboxes
description:
List named sandboxes in a project, sorted by creation time or name. Optionally filter by name prefix (only when sortBy is name), status (only when sortBy is createdAt), or one key:value tag. Paginated with an opaque cursor.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of named sandboxes to return in the response. Used for pagination.

namePrefix.description: Filter named sandboxes whose name starts with this prefix. Only valid when sortBy=name.

project.description: The unique identifier or name of the project to list named sandboxes for.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

status.description: Filter named sandboxes by status. Only valid when sortBy is createdAt.

tags.description: Filter sandboxes by tag. Format: \"key:value\". Only one tag filter is supported at a time.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
